#!/bin/sh
# Flux batch script converted from Slurm

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# Slurm resources:
#   -A lu2020-2-7
#   -p lu
#   -t 2:00:00
#   -J snre_b
#   -o lunarc_output/lunarc_output_snre_b_%j.out
#   -e lunarc_output/lunarc_output_snre_b_%j.err
#   --mail-user=...
#   --mail-type=ALL

#flux: --job-name=snre_b
#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 1
#flux: --time-limit=2h

# Omitted Slurm option: -A lu2020-2-7 (account)
# Flux accounting/project selection is site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may be charged to a default account or be rejected by policy.

# Omitted Slurm option: -p lu (partition)
# Flux queues/partitions are site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may run on different nodes than intended or have different limits/priority (or be rejected by policy).

# Omitted Slurm options: -o/-e with %j token
# Slurm's %j token (job id) is not portable in Flux output/error directives.
# Performance implication: none, but logs may overwrite/collide unless you choose unique filenames.

# Omitted Slurm options: --mail-user and --mail-type
# Flux does not provide a universal, built-in email notification directive in batch scripts.
# Performance implication: none on runtime performance, but you will not receive automatic job emails.

ml load GCC/8.3.0
ml load CUDA/10.1.243
ml load OpenMPI/3.1.4
ml load PyTorch/1.6.0-Python-3.7.4

python /home/samwiq/snpla/seq-posterior-approx-w-nf-dev/two_moons/run_script_snre_b.py 1 2 17 10 0

reasons: The original Slurm job specified an account (`-A lu2020-2-7`) and partition (`-p lu`), but the Flux resource section has no queue/account selection; on sites where these are required for eligibility or limits, scheduling behavior may differ or the job may be rejected.

#!/bin/sh


#SBATCH -A lu2020-2-7
#SBATCH -p lu

# time consumption HH:MM:SS
#SBATCH -t 2:00:00

# #SBATCH -N 1
# #SBATCH --tasks-per-node=1
# #SBATCH --exclusive

# name for script
#SBATCH -J snre_b

 
# controll job outputs
#SBATCH -o lunarc_output/lunarc_output_snre_b_%j.out
#SBATCH -e lunarc_output/lunarc_output_snre_b_%j.err

# notification
#SBATCH --mail-user=samuel.wiqvist@matstat.lu.se
#SBATCH --mail-type=ALL

# load modules

ml load GCC/8.3.0
ml load CUDA/10.1.243
ml load OpenMPI/3.1.4
ml load PyTorch/1.6.0-Python-3.7.4

# run program
python /home/samwiq/snpla/'seq-posterior-approx-w-nf-dev'/'two_moons'/run_script_snre_b.py 1 2 17 10 0
